title: I Gave Claude One File And It Became My Brand Team
description:
Claude writes generic marketing copy because it does not know your business. The fix is a single brand context file that every skill and every chat reads before it writes a word. This short covers what goes in that file, how to install Anthropic's own free marketing skills in three lines, and how to load the file into Claude Projects if you never touch a terminal.

Covered: the brand context template, the official Anthropic Marketing plugin, and how to check any community skill before you install it.

Get the full template and guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JI1k0NMv_bMOoJI8t9wgdVc5P9yaJXTgK4PZc88OUoA/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #ClaudeAI #Branding
